about: Synthetic brain of a fictional solo maker who runs a small online ceramics shop. No real person, company or infrastructure. Each engram has a stable `key` the questions refer to; `age_days` sets its creation time relative to the run; `supersedes` names keys of earlier engrams it replaces.

projects.name: Companion app
projects.goal: Mobile app for orders and new collections

projects.name: Blog and newsletter
projects.goal: Studio stories and a monthly newsletter

engrams.title: tests-before-push
engrams.content: Run the full test suite before every push; never push with failing tests.

engrams.title: commit-messages-english
engrams.content: Write commit messages in English, imperative mood, one change per commit.

engrams.title: no-friday-deploys
engrams.content: No production deploys on Fridays after 14:00; wait until Monday morning.

engrams.title: snapshot-before-migration
engrams.content: Take a database snapshot before running any migration or bulk import on shop data.

properties.trigger: running a migration or bulk import

engrams.title: approve-customer-emails
engrams.content: Never send an email to customers without Alex approving the exact text first.

engrams.title: test-on-oldest-device
engrams.content: Test every app build on the oldest supported device (iPhone SE 2nd gen) before it goes out.

engrams.title: shop
engrams.content: Shop runs on WooCommerce on shared hosting. Checkout takes about 4 seconds; customers complain.

engrams.title: shop-platform
engrams.content: Keep the shop on WooCommerce and tune the shared hosting instead of switching platforms.

properties.rationale: Switching costs a lot of time; caching might fix the slow checkout.

engrams.title: shop-platform
engrams.content: Move the shop from WooCommerce to Shopify.

properties.rationale: Caching did not fix checkout; hosting maintenance eats the time meant for pottery.

engrams.title: payment-provider
engrams.content: Use Stripe for card payments and PayPal as the second option.

properties.rationale: Stripe has the lowest fees for small baskets; PayPal is what older customers expect.

engrams.title: shipping-carrier
engrams.content: Ship all parcels with DHL.

properties.rationale: One carrier keeps the packing station simple.

engrams.title: shipping-carrier
engrams.content: Ship small parcels up to 1 kg with Deutsche Post Warenpost; fragile and larger parcels stay with DHL.

properties.rationale: Warenpost halves the cost for single mugs; DHL insurance is still needed for fragile items.

engrams.title: pricing-formula
engrams.content: Price formula: material cost x 2.5 plus 12 EUR handling. Glazed items get a 15 % surcharge on top of that.

engrams.title: returns-policy
engrams.content: Returns are accepted within 30 days. The customer pays return shipping, unless the item arrived broken: then a photo is enough and they get a full refund without sending it back.

engrams.title: clay-supplier
engrams.content: Clay comes from a supplier in the Westerwald region. Order every six weeks, minimum order 200 kg, delivery takes about ten days.

engrams.title: theme-deploy
engrams.content: Shop theme changes are deployed with the Shopify CLI (shopify theme push) from the theme repository. Always push to the preview theme first and check checkout on mobile.

engrams.title: product-import
engrams.content: Import all products with images and variants from WooCommerce into Shopify.

properties.outcome: imported 214 products; 6 variants fixed by hand

engrams.title: product-photos
engrams.content: Reshoot the product photos for the spring collection with the daylight setup.

engrams.title: seo-category-texts
engrams.content: Write category texts for mugs, bowls and vases (150 to 200 words each) for search engines.

engrams.title: shop
engrams.content: Shop is live on Shopify; the old WooCommerce site redirects. Checkout now loads in under one second.

engrams.title: shopify-go-live
engrams.content: The Shopify shop went live; DNS switched over in the morning, first order 40 minutes later.

engrams.title: app-framework
engrams.content: Build the app with React Native and Expo.

properties.rationale: Same TypeScript stack as the rest; one codebase for iOS and Android.

engrams.title: app-backend
engrams.content: The app talks to a small own Node API on the VPS, which reads orders and products from WooCommerce.

properties.rationale: The WooCommerce REST API is too slow to call from the phone.
alternatives: Call the WooCommerce REST API directly

engrams.title: app-backend
engrams.content: The app reads products and orders directly from the Shopify Storefront API; the own Node API is shut down.

properties.rationale: Shopify's Storefront API is fast enough; one server less to run.
alternatives: Keep the own Node API in front of Shopify

engrams.title: app-release-process
engrams.content: App release: bump the version, run an EAS build, submit with EAS submit. iOS goes to TestFlight first, Android to the internal testing track.

engrams.title: beta-feedback
engrams.content: Beta tester feedback round one: the magic-link login confuses people (12 mentions), they want order tracking in the app, and the app crashes on iPad in split view.

engrams.title: android-push
engrams.content: Set up Firebase Cloud Messaging so the Android build can receive push notifications.

engrams.title: app-store-submission
engrams.content: Submit the iOS app for App Store review once the second beta feedback round is done.

engrams.title: app
engrams.content: App is in TestFlight beta with 40 testers. The Android build is blocked on the push notification setup.

engrams.title: infra
engrams.content: Shared hosting for the shop, one VPS for the blog and the app API.

engrams.title: backup-strategy
engrams.content: Back up the VPS every night with restic to object storage, keep 30 days.

properties.rationale: Provider snapshots alone are not off-site and not restorable file by file.

engrams.title: server-access
engrams.content: Server access is by SSH key only; port 22 is closed to the internet and reachable through WireGuard.

engrams.title: tls-renewal
engrams.content: Automate TLS certificate renewal for blog and API.

properties.outcome: Caddy renews certificates on its own

engrams.title: uptime-monitoring
engrams.content: Set up uptime monitoring for shop, blog and newsletter with alerts to the phone.

engrams.title: blog-outage
engrams.content: The blog was down for three hours because the disk filled up with logs; fixed by adding log rotation.

engrams.title: infra
engrams.content: One VPS left; it hosts the blog and the newsletter. The WooCommerce shared hosting is cancelled at the end of the month.

engrams.title: blog
engrams.content: Blog runs on Ghost, two posts per month, the newsletter has about 600 subscribers.

engrams.title: newsletter-tool
engrams.content: Send the newsletter with Ghost's built-in newsletter feature.

properties.rationale: Already part of the blog; no second tool and no second subscriber list.

engrams.title: blog-theme-deploy
engrams.content: The Ghost theme is deployed by uploading the zip in the Ghost admin; CI builds the zip on every push to main.

engrams.title: content-plan
engrams.content: Blog topics this quarter: the glazing process, a studio tour, a gift guide (must be out before 1 December), care instructions for glazed pieces.

engrams.title: post-glazing-process
engrams.content: Write the blog post about the glazing process, with photos from the last firing.

engrams.title: tax-setup
engrams.content: The business is VAT-exempt as a small business until yearly revenue passes 22,000 EUR; then VAT has to be charged. Revenue so far this year: about 18,000 EUR.

engrams.title: accounting-tool
engrams.content: Do the bookkeeping in lexoffice.

properties.rationale: Bank sync and receipts from the phone; the tax advisor works with it.
